Count all extant regular-file bytes at the first authenticated census, including provider action inputs already materialized. ## Fixed commands and clocks

After fixed bootstrap/authentication and source acquisition, B then C each use:

```
<authenticated-go> test -tags=treedb_test -p=1 -mod=readonly -c -overlay=<arm-json> -o=<task>/bin/<arm>-primary.test ./TreeDB/mvcc
<authenticated-go> version -m <task>/bin/<arm>-primary.test
```

Each build has 360s and buildinfo 30s, always clipped to the one 840s construction clock begun by bootstrap. The outer bound is 900s, including bounded cleanup; the hosted job timeout is 15 minutes and does not extend it. No ELF is executed. Two sparse raw source sets total 244,761,392B; Git/module/cache/tmp/ELF overlap and elapsed fit remain measured questions, not successful-build prerequisites. Retain both roots/caches/ELFs. A future capture is separately unadmitted and keeps its original 1GiB all-new / 32MiB log-profile / 90s per arm / 180s active / 200s outer / CPU0 / GOMAXPROCS1 requirements; this construction does not enlarge them.
